synthesizedFacts.fact: Vitamin C should not be mixed with AHA/BHA due to potential pH imbalance and reduced effectiveness.
Mixing Vitamin C with Retinol can cause skin irritation due to differing pH levels.
Vitamin C and Benzoyl Peroxide should not be used together as they can oxidize each other, reducing effectiveness.
Peptides and Vitamin C should not be mixed as they can interfere with each other's stability and effectiveness.
